content.title: A home for people who love data work
content.lead: Thousands of practitioners share patterns, answer questions and meet in person to make analytics engineering better for everyone.

content.title: Practitioners helping practitioners grow
content.body: From forum threads to regional meetups, the Lattice community is where people trade ideas, review each other’s projects and help steer the direction of the open engine and the platform.

content.title: What is happening in the community

feature.title: This season’s award winners
feature.body: Every season the community nominates members who went out of their way to help others. This round recognizes organizers who started meetups in six new cities, maintainers who reviewed hundreds of package contributions, and writers whose guides helped newcomers ship their first models. Read their stories and nominate someone for the next round.

member.quote: I joined to ask one question about incremental models and stayed because people kept helping. Now I run a meetup with two hundred members and still learn something every month.

content.title: Shape the tools you use every single day
content.body: The open engine, the package hub and the documentation all improve because community members report issues, review changes and share what they have learned along the way.

cards.title: Contribute to the engine
cards.body: Pick up a good first issue or review an open pull request.

cards.title: Publish a package
cards.body: Share reusable macros and models with thousands of other teams.

cards.title: Improve the documentation
cards.body: Fix a typo, clarify a concept or write a new how-to guide.

content.title: There is a place here for you
content.body: Whether you want to learn, teach, organize or simply listen, there is a way to take part that fits your schedule and the way you like to work.

cards.title: Forum
cards.body: Ask a question and get answers from experienced practitioners worldwide.

cards.title: Local meetups
cards.body: Meet people in your city for talks, demos and plenty of conversation.

cards.title: Office hours
cards.body: Drop in to weekly sessions with the team behind the product and docs.

cards.title: Community awards
cards.body: Nominate someone whose help made a real difference to your own work.

cards.title: Partner network
cards.body: Work with consultancies and technology partners who know the platform.

cards.title: Speak at an event
cards.body: Share a project, a lesson learned or a pattern with a friendly crowd.

content.title: Your first step into the community
content.body: Create a free account, introduce yourself in the forum and find a meetup near you. Everyone is welcome, whatever your level.
